COURT’S OR JUDGE’S ORDERS
CRLR No.780 of 2025
Hon’ble Alok Mahra, J.
Mr. Gaurav Singh, learned counsel
for the revisionist.
2. Mr. Nishant Pande and Ankit Rana, 
learned counsel for respondent.
3. Learned counsel for the parties 
would submit that there is a possibility of 
an amicable settlement between the 
parties and, therefore, prayed that the 
parties be directed to appear before this 
Court to explore the possibility of 
resolving the dispute amicably.
4. In view of the above, list this case on 
15.07.2026. 
5. The revisionist and respondent shall 
remain present before this Court on 
15.07.2026 at 10:30 A.M. to explore the 
possibility of an amicable settlement 
between the parties. 
6. It is made clear that if either party 
faces any difficulty in appearing before the 
Court on the date fixed, he/she shall 
inform the other party in advance.
7. List this case on 15.07.2026.
8. Interim order dated 10.12.2025 to 
continue till the next date of listing.
 (Alok Mahra, J.) 17.06.2026 Mamta

2. Today, the matter was referred for mediation 
and the parties were directed to appear before the 
learned Mediator.
3. As per the report submitted by the learned 
Mediator, sincere efforts were made to amicably 
resolve the dispute between the parties; however, the 
mediation proceedings remained unsuccessful and no 
settlement could be arrived at.
4. List this case on 20.08.2026 for final hearing.
(Alok Mahra, J.)
